name: Distributed Durable ACK and Runtime Authority Convergence
description: Implement the durable ACK layer: every terminal Valkey ACK must be preceded by a committed PGlite lifecycle write. Build completeAndAck, failTerminalAndAck, failRetryableAndAck, deadLetterAndAck with PGlite-first ordering. Wire recovery receipts, scheduler promotion, and pending reconciliation.
purpose: Implement durable-first authority: PGlite writes always precede Valkey ACKs. No claim without observable backing.
acceptanceCriteria: durable-store.ts exports WorkQueueDurableStoreService with PGlite-backed failTerminal/retry/scheduler methods
work-queue.ts parses and typechecks — completeAndAck/failTerminalAndAck/failRetryableAndAck/deadLetterAndAck all write PGlite before XACK
recovery.ts setRecoveryState and getRecoveryState persist to PGlite
observability.ts inspectWorkItem reads real PGlite rows
Tests assert PGlite rows match Valkey stream/PEL state after every terminal ACK
